packageRules.description: Never take a `…-compat` backport artifact, and never a `-SNAPSHOT`. JetBrains publishes compatibility variants of the kotlinx libraries under a `<version>-<oldline>.x-compat` suffix and Renovate's gradle versioning ranks that suffix ABOVE the plain release, so it proposes a downgrade of API surface dressed as an upgrade. The `-SNAPSHOT` half matters here because `robolectric` sits on a beta (`4.17-beta-4`) and Robolectric publishes a rolling `4.17-SNAPSHOT` that Renovate ranks above it — this build declares no snapshot repository, so that bump resolves nowhere and fails every Android configuration. Both rules set `allowedVersions` and the last match wins, so the two suffixes are filtered in one rule rather than two.
Keep Coil on stable 3.6.x alongside CMP 1.12.x; review the next minor line with its Compose/Skiko requirements.
Keep Compose Multiplatform on stable 1.12.x patches. The player uses compileSdk 37 and the conic-to-quads Skiko seam; review newer minor lines with Coil and published consumer requirements.

Hold AndroidX Compose core dependencies on 1.12.x. The vendored Remote Compose player intentionally shares the CMP Android floor (1.12.1); raising the minor line changes published consumer requirements and must be reviewed with CMP. Keep the BOM, Material3 and Remote Compose alpha coordinates under their separate policies.

Remote Compose and its Wear widget layer resolve from Google Maven on released alpha coordinates, and the groups only work together when built against the same `remote-creation*` — `remote-material3` names that version in its POM, and `settings.gradle.kts` enforces the same constraint for the release/snapshot flip (`composeai.remoteCompose`), flipping every key at once so no group straddles the line. Renovate updates one dependency at a time, so an automated bump of any one group produces exactly that skew. Bump `compose-remote` and `wear-compose-remote` in gradle/libs.versions.toml as one set after checking the POMs, and re-verify a render, not just a compile.

One PR a week for the workflow pins rather than one per action: these land as a workflow-only change that the same required checks gate, and reviewing them together is how a bad action bump is spotted.
Update this release BOM independently; module versions come from its constraints.
